brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Two-tier shelf formed by piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full + piece:1,0,0;full with covers cover:0,0,1;full;top and cover:1,0,0;full;top providing flat shelves for books; book-stack prop placed on upper cover shows use.

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Configurator checks geometry/fit and mesh clearance only (meshClash clear). Parts are 3D-printed plastic with user-chosen material; no structural analysis, load rating, or material certification is available. Cannot claim 50 kg capacity. Build is a light-duty display/storage form, not certified for heavy book loads.
drawer:0#0,1#cut at 0,1,0 and drawer:0#1,1#cut at 1,1,0 on half-s bases, both functional pull-out drawers.

finish.summary: Built compact 2-tier shelf unit with two drawers and staged with books. Geometry is verified (mesh clear, joints locked) but 50 kg load rating cannot be met by this system - printed plastic parts are not load-rated and no strength testing is performed. Use for light items only or reinforce/replace with rated furniture for heavy book loads.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
